title: From detections to anchored labels
takeaway: Locate the object, then retain its label at a native spatial anchor.
notes: Related work: Augmented Object Intelligence with XR-Objects, Dogan et al., UIST2024, doi10.1145/3654777.3676379, https://xr-objects.github.io/. Original evaluated phone prototype uses ARFoundation/ARCore + on-device MediaPipe object detection and cloud PaLI. Our immediate scope is detection, localization, and session-anchored labels. Menus, selection, LLM, and actions are not implemented or required here.

title: Detection is not yet tracking
takeaway: Each additional capability needs a new representation.
notes: Source: QuestYolo.cs Observe() associates class/proximity observations with session-local OVRSpatialAnchor records. Native0.3.1 ignores <=.20m jitter, requires3consistent observations within.10m plus1scooldown, then creates a replacement native anchor. Old content stays until replacementLocalizes+Tracks; child text billboards only. Adaptive evidencegap=max(1s,3xinferencecadence). No general moving-object tracker or saved cross-relaunch anchors. Center ray surface point is not geometric object center.

title: How it runs on the headset
takeaway: Pixels provide semantics; geometry places the result in the room.
notes: Source QuestYolo.cs Start(), Decode(), Observe(), Update(). Snapshot640x640; YOLOv9 ONNX, confidence.35 class-aware NMS.45. Exposure-time center ray hits depth, new native anchor created once; same-class matching updates metadata only. Localized+IsTracked gates label visibility. No corner-plane boxes.

title: A center hit becomes a stable label
takeaway: A native spatial anchor retains the measured location.
notes: Native0.3.1: calibrated center ray from exposure-time camera pose hits environment depth P. A new independent root receives OVRSpatialAnchor once at P. Later detections inside the deadband update metadata only; confirmed larger shifts replace the native anchor without dragging its transform. Only text child billboards. The initial hit can be background; session anchor is not moving-object tracking or saved cross-relaunch persistence.
